title: feat: complete Q2 §2.7 Console UX — favorites, onboarding, global search
body:
Implements remaining Q2 §2.7 Console UX Enhancement items from ROADMAP.md and checks off items that were already shipped but unmarked.

### New features

- **`useFavorites` hook** — localStorage-persisted favorites (`objectui-favorites`, max 20), API mirrors `useRecentItems`: `addFavorite`, `removeFavorite`, `toggleFavorite`, `isFavorite`, `clearFavorites`
- **Favorites sidebar section** — renders above Recent items using `SidebarMenuAction` with `showOnHover` for unfavorite
- **Onboarding walkthrough** — 4-step dialog (Navigate, ⌘K Search, Favorites, Shortcuts), auto-shown on first visit, dismissed via `objectui-onboarding-dismissed` localStorage key
- **Global search results page** — `/apps/:appName/search?q=...` route with categorized results grouped by type; "Open Full Search Page" action added to command palette

### ROADMAP updates

Checked off all 6 items in §2.7:
- `[x]` Skeleton loading states (already existed)
- `[x]` Toast notifications for CRUD (already existed via Sonner)
- `[x]` Responsive sidebar auto-collapse (already existed via `useResponsiveSidebar`)
- `[x]` Onboarding walkthrough (new)
- `[x]` Global search results page (new)
- `[x]` Recent items / favorites in sidebar (favorites new, recent already existed)

### Tests

- 9 tests for `useFavorites` (add, deduplicate, remove, toggle, isFavorite, max cap, clear, persistence)
- 6 tests for `OnboardingWalkthrough` (first-time show, dismissed skip, step navigation, localStorage persistence)
